title: Profile of Jobs and Industries on Fair Consideration Framework Watchlist
what_it_is: Profile of Jobs and Industries on Fair Consideration Framework Watchlist

sections.label: FCF Watchlist firms and hiring
sections.summary: About 350 firms on the FCF Watchlist face longer Employment Pass processing and have hired over 2,000 Singaporean PMETs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Currently, about 350 firms are on the FCF Watchlist.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Administrative and Support Services, Construction, Education, Infocomm and Professional Services are among the top five sectors which firms on the FCF Watchlist belong to.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: These firms employ a range of occupations, such as architects and engineers, business professionals, information technology (IT) professionals and managers with many being paid between $3,000 and $10,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Firms on the FCF Watchlist will have their Employment Pass applications scrutinised and, consequently, experience longer processing times.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: To date, over 2,000 Singaporean professionals, managers, executives and technicians (PMETs) have been hired by firms on the FCF Watchlist.

sections.label: Expanded job advertising requirement
sections.summary: More companies employing Employment Pass holders must advertise jobs, now covering firms hiring 10 or more persons.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We have expanded the requirement so that more companies that employ Employment Pass holders have to make known the jobs that they are seeking candidates for.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: It used to be that for jobs that pay up to $12,000, you have to advertise; we have expanded it.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: It used to be that you have to hire more than 25 persons.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Now, as long as you hire 10 or more persons, you are covered.

sections.label: Not penalising Singaporean employees
sections.summary: Firms on the Watchlist remain employers of Singaporeans, and their Singaporean employees should not be unfairly penalised.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Whilst these firms may be on the Watchlist, and we are working with them to improve their hiring practices, in the meantime, they are still employers of Singaporeans, and we do not want to unfairly penalise their Singaporean employees whilst they are going through this process.
